filter_initial_state: zero; reset each EDF; retain state across blocks
normalization: 4-second features retain previous causal extractor. Additional 2-second features reference only earlier complete windows of the same EDF, with deterministic 0/1 initialization. No labels or pooled validation/test statistics.
architecture: Own 4-second TCN-GRU plus 2-second instantaneous shared-channel head. Learned logit fusion with auxiliary head losses. Integrated hypothesis, not an ablation or efficacy claim.

training.selection: Within each fold only: acceptance, macro event sensitivity, pooled event sensitivity, macro AP, fewer FA/h, less alarm time; earliest epoch on exact tie. Save every epoch validation probabilities for audit.

selection: Select validation operating point under frozen numeric acceptance criteria (pooled >= 70%, macro >= 60%, no zero-detection person, FA/h <= 1.0, alarm time <= 5%). Both one-to-one positive overlap and strict onset-inside-seizure are reported. Single test evaluation only if validation accepts.
test_policy: Freeze all five models and validation-selected rules before any outer test. Evaluate ALL folds including validation failures once. No selection/exclusion from test.
sequence_policy: 24 acquired scores, 1s advance, overlapping inference stride12, state resets per block/EDF; no mandatory wait24s for first output. Fixed-grid causal batching with prefix invariance.

pilot.scope: One fixed TRAIN batch; dropout off; weights discarded. Must decrease focal asymmetric BCE at least 20% before long run.

event_scoring: One-to-one positive overlap, zero tolerance, no merge/split; onset-inside comparison and full alarm burden always reported.
hypothesis: Brief-event hypothesis: 2s+4s features, fast instantaneous head, event-balanced TRAIN sampling and twofold weight on the first four positive seconds. CV measures stability separately; no promised gain.
